channel.title: Patchwork – Patch Notes
channel.description: Latest patch notes, summarized: buffs, nerfs and bug fixes at a glance.

item.title: Infinity Nikki: Infinity Nikki Version 3.0 Patch Notes
item.description: Infinity Nikki Version 3.0 'Of Yesterday and Tomorrow' brings fixes for mobile device quest and event issues, outerwear movement glitches, and dyeing display errors.

item.title: Once Human: November 26 Patch 3.2.1
item.description: The Once Human 3.2.1 update fixes issues related to getting stuck after teleporting in Resonant Movements and inaccuracies when adjusting design layout heights on Custom Servers.

item.title: Hearts of Iron IV: Hearts of Iron IV Patch 1.20.1 & Studio Gold Update
item.description: Patch 1.20.1 brings balance tweaks to Balkan mechanics and bug fixes for the Romanian focus tree. Additionally, the Studio Gold update introduces a major multiplayer networking overhaul using AI tools to combat cheaters and griefers.

item.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Patch 5.02
item.description: Patch 5.02 for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is now live. This update brings gameplay and balance adjustments, visual improvements, photo mode updates, and numerous bug fixes across the Continent.
